### Observed differences

- In the later window, A01 and A17 are no longer observed in any of the 200 traces. Before, A01 appeared in about 64 in 100 traces (about 0.9 occurrences per trace, always followed by A09) and A17 appeared exactly once in every trace near the end, forming an adjacent final pair with A10 in either order; A12, which previously often led to A01, now leads to A08 or A09. [OCC001, OCC015, DIR001, DIR008, DIR009, DIR013, POS017, REL114]
- A07 is newly observed: from 0 of 200 traces before to about 68 in 100 in the later window, about once per trace and very early (median relative position about 0.06); A03 leads to it in about half of its outgoing transitions, and A07 leads back to A03 or A04. [OCC006, DIR003, DIR006, POS007, REL035, REL048]
- The ending changed. Before, A04 led to A10 (about 52 in 100 outgoing transitions) or directly to A17 (about 48). In the later window, A04 always leads to A10, A10 leads only to A06 (about 48) or A16 (about 52), and A06 and A16 occur exactly once in every trace, adjacent to each other at the very end (mean relative positions about 0.96 and 0.94) in either order. [DIR004, DIR005, DIR008, DIR012, OCC005, OCC014, POS006, POS016, REL047, REL079, REL113, LAG027, LAG033, LAG086]
- A06 and A16 changed role: before they were optional and repeated (each in about 40 in 100 traces, about 2 occurrences per trace, alternating with each other and with A14 and A15); in the later window each occurs exactly once in every trace, at the end. [OCC005, OCC014, DIR005, DIR012, POS006, POS016]
- A02 became strongly repeated: from about 2 to about 9 occurrences per trace while participation stayed near 69–70 in 100 traces. Its outgoing transitions moved entirely from A16, A06, A03 and A04 to A15, A11, A14 and A12, A13 now always leads back to A02, and A14 and A15 rose from about 1 to about 4.5 occurrences per trace (A14 now leads to A15 or to itself). [OCC002, OCC012, OCC013, DIR002, DIR010, DIR011, LAG001, REL018, REL025]
- Smaller shifts: participation and repetitions rose modestly for A03, A05, A08, A09, A11, A12 and A13 (for example A05 and A13 from about 3.4 to about 4.4 occurrences per trace); A10 now sits earlier within traces (mean relative position about 0.95 to 0.81) and A09 later (about 0.64 to 0.71). [OCC003, OCC004, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009, OCC010, OCC011, POS004, POS009, POS010]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility of a structural reorganisation of the control flow. In the later window, the former ending — A04 leading to an adjacent terminal pair A10/A17 present in every trace in either order — no longer occurs; instead A04 always leads to A10 and A10 leads to A06 and A16, which now occur exactly once per trace as an adjacent final pair, while A17 is no longer observed. A01 (previously in about 64 in 100 traces, always followed by A09) is also no longer observed, A07 (previously unobserved) now appears early in about 68 in 100 traces, reached from A03 and leading back to A03 or A04, and A02 became the centre of a strongly repeated loop with A11, A12, A14 and A15 (about 2 to about 9 occurrences per trace), fed by A13, with A14 and A15 repeating about four to five times as often as before. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC005, OCC006, OCC012, OCC014, OCC015, DIR002, DIR004, DIR005, DIR008, DIR010, DIR011, DIR012, DIR013, POS006, POS016, REL047, REL056, REL073, REL079, REL113, LAG027, LAG033, LAG086]

The signs are direct rather than circumstantial: participation flips from 128–200 of 200 traces to 0 of 200 (A01, A17) and from 0 to 136 of 200 (A07); successor profiles are replaced wholesale for A02, A07, A10, A13, A14 and A16, each difference larger than in about 995 of 1,000 random re-splits; A04 now co-occurs with A06 and A16 in every trace and always precedes them (before, about 40 in 100); and the new block appears as immediate succession in the lag evidence (A04→A10, A06→A16 and A16→A06 all at lag 1 in the later window). [OCC001, OCC006, OCC015, DIR002, DIR006, DIR008, DIR010, DIR011, DIR012, REL047, REL056, LAG027, LAG033, LAG086]

The main competing explanation the evidence cannot fully exclude is that A01 and A17 still occur but were absent from this particular later sample, since zero participation only means "not observed"; their earlier presence in about 64 in 100 and in all 200 traces makes a sampling explanation implausible but not impossible. The evidence also cannot show whether the restructuring was introduced as one coordinated change or as several separate ones, and because several indicators describe the same traces, the agreeing items are not independent confirmations. [OCC001, OCC015]

Other differences: participation and repetitions rose modestly for A03, A05, A08, A09, A11, A12 and A13 (for example A05 and A13 from about 3.4 to about 4.4 occurrences per trace, participation from about 64 to about 70 in 100 traces); A10 moved earlier within traces and A09 later; and A09's split between leading to A03 and A04 shifted slightly (about 47/53 to about 55/45). These are consistent with the restructuring above but are not its core. [OCC003, OCC004, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009, OCC010, OCC011, POS004, POS009, POS010, DIR007]
